note: Feed-level continuity and variation rules for Kaduse Medikal, Category 8 of the Visual Quality P2 programme (see VISUAL-SYSTEM.md). Governs rhythm and controlled variation across posts -- it does NOT force a rigid checkerboard or a fixed rotation order. Every rule here is a soft target band a composition should move toward, evaluated against the channel's own recent history, not a hard per-post gate. Consumed as feed-context input to composition (recentPosts, targetGridPosition, recentSurfaceModes, recentDominantColors, recentProductCrops, recentModuleFamilies) -- see feedContextInput below for the exact shape.

rollingWindow.reason: Matches a 3x3 Instagram profile-grid preview -- the unit both the surface-rhythm and archetype-distribution targets below are evaluated against.

darkLightBand.note: Relational feed guidance derived from the approved North Star and reference feed. It must never hard-fail a post or force a checkerboard.

surfaceRhythm.note: Prefer breaking a run of 2 consecutive posts in the identical surface mode before starting a 3rd, unless the composition's own thesis genuinely calls for continuing the run (e.g. a stated 2-3 post visual sub-series).

archetypeDistribution.note: Guidance for feed variety, not a content-selection rule -- content/archetype selection itself stays owned by each archetype's own policy file under content/policies/. This block only informs composition of how visually 'product-heavy' the current window already is.

logoZones.rule: Keep a stable top-left logo anchor by default. Use another approved zone only when the composition provides an explicit rationale; every placement remains subject to logo safe-zone and integrity checks.

frameContinuity.note: 'none' (no frame) is a real, countable option in this rotation -- a frame is a preferred default for feed coherence, not a mandatory element on every post (VISUAL-SYSTEM.md §4).

footerContinuity.typeSizeBand: Hold footer text inside typography-roles.json's footer role sizeRangePx across posts that do carry a footer -- do not vary the footer type scale post-to-post without a stated compositional reason.
footerContinuity.note: 'none' is valid when a full-bleed or sculptural composition is clearly stronger (VISUAL-SYSTEM.md §5); it is still a countable feed state so two consecutive footer-less posts register the same as any other repeated family.

coral500.note: Operationalizes 'coral stays a selective accent, not a routine decorative color' (VISUAL-SYSTEM.md §7). The cap applies to coral used as a large/primary compositional field or shape -- not to a small CTA chip, accent dot, or single-word highlight, which are unrestricted.

imageDensityRhythm.adjacentTileRule: Avoid the same band on 3+ consecutive posts; specifically avoid three consecutive full-bleed product-photo tiles reading as one undifferentiated block in the grid.
imageDensityRhythm.note: IMAGE_FORWARD = full product hero / macro / sculptural tubing composition dominates the frame. TYPOGRAPHY_FORWARD = message-led, no or minimal product image. BALANCED = deliberate product+type composition, neither dominates.

typographyRhythm.note: Select the combination by archetype and content role. Both combinations share EB Garamond; body treatment changes between Inter and IBM Plex Sans. No rare-accent layer exists for Kaduse.

cropRepetitionPrevention.note: Stricter than the frame/surface rules by design -- identical product crop back-to-back is the single most common source of the 'PNG pasted on a canvas, again' complaint this programme exists to fix. A different crop family is required on the very next product-bearing post, not merely preferred.

neighboringGridRelationship.rule: When composing a new post, check the most recent 1-2 posts (its likely adjacent tiles in a 3-column profile grid) for these four properties and prefer a composition that reads as distinct from its immediate neighbors, even if the rolling-window targets above are otherwise satisfied.
neighboringGridRelationship.note: This is a local (adjacent-tile) check layered on top of the window-level targets above, not a replacement for them.

shape.recentPosts: array of the last N published/approved posts: { postId, archetype, surfaceMode, dominantColors, productCrop, frameFamily, footerFamily, typographyCombinationId, publishedAt }
shape.targetGridPosition: 0-based index of the new post's expected position in the 3x3 preview

feedContextInput.note: Add this block to composition input where technically appropriate (channel-content-os's compose_post / Creative Director candidate assembly) -- this file defines the contract shape; it does not itself implement the wiring.

previewRequirement.note: A single post may receive INDIVIDUAL_POST_APPROVAL without a complete 3x3. FEED_SYSTEM_APPROVAL requires a real multi-post preview. PUBLISH_APPROVAL is always separate.
